name: Integrated Child Development Services Scheme
benefit: The ICDS Scheme offers a package of six services, Supplementary nutrition. Immunization. Health check-up. Referral services. Pre-school non-formal education andNutrition & Health Education.
eligibility_rules: The children up to the age of 6 years. Pregnant women. Lactating mothers.
The children above the age of 6 years is not eligible.
exclusions: The children above the age of 6 years is not eligible.
documents_required: required documentsAadhaar CardPassport Sized PhotographProof of Age / DOBProof of Address.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Application ProcessApplicants need to visit the nearest Anganwadi centres to avail the benefits of the scheme.
